scope: Official Hawaii 2024 result/review text parser pins precinct 13-09 to Kalawao FIPS 15005. The 2012/2016/2020 historical normalizer uses explicit pre-reapportionment district ranges for each year, separates 13-09 from Maui, asserts every county tuple and statewide total, and preserves the 2012 overseas non-geographic votes outside county rows. State-native Office turnout remains four rows because Kalawao is not separate in the turnout table. Production promotion was not performed.

crosswalkEvidence.authority: Hawaii Office of Elections; Hawaii Reapportionment Commission
crosswalkEvidence.reviewedFinding: The official March 30, 2012 reapportionment maps establish House districts 01-07 in Hawaii County, 08-13 in Maui/Kalawao, 14-16 in Kauai County, and 17-51 in Honolulu. The Office compilation includes the May 2012 Molokai election map, draws the Maui-Kalawao county boundary, and identifies precinct 13-09 on the Kalawao side.

historicalBaselines.notes: Official 2012, 2016, and 2020 summary/detail text files are normalized reproducibly with their pre-reapportionment district ranges. Nine supporting 2012 Office/Reapportionment Commission PDFs are retained and hash-pinned in the generated reconciliation manifest: the four March 2012 county map sheets, the Office's Molokai compilation containing the May 2012 13-09/Kalawao map, and four certified election-county summaries. The county summaries independently reconcile after 13-09 is split from the Maui-administered total into Kalawao FIPS 15005. The 2012 detail source's Reg_voters and Ballots fields remain source context only, and its 476 overseas non-geographic President votes remain outside county rows. Every evidence hash, county tuple, statewide total, election-county summary, and non-geographic exclusion is asserted.
